stories.message: Could not sign in as the owner to reach /manage/menu: the admin password sign-in control at /login ('Admin? Sign in with a password' → email+password → Sign in) is non-functional. Reproduced with 8+ independent selector strategies (CSS adjacent-sibling, tag+text compound, ARIA accessible name) that all resolved to the same real <button> element; clicking it with correct or incorrect credentials produces zero network requests, zero console errors and no UI change. The same click mechanism worked correctly on every other button in the app (admin-toggle, Add to basket, Place order, Save password). Confirmed the backend itself is fine: POST /AuthApi/password with the owner's credentials returns 200 with the admin user object when hit directly (not through this broken control). Because browser_sign_in has no 'link' entry for the admin role, there is no way to obtain an authenticated owner browser session, so this story -- the main subject of this QA pass -- could not be exercised.
evidence: 8 reproduced click attempts on /login admin form (button[type=submit], form:last-of-type button, input[type=password]+button, aria/Sign in[role=button], button::-p-text(Sign in), etc.) all produced network count:0, console count:0, no DOM change

stories.message: Same blocker as add-menu-item-works: the owner cannot sign in through the UI because the admin password sign-in submit button does nothing when clicked (no network call, no error), so /manage/menu could not be reached as the owner and the previously-reported MenuAdminApi 400 fix could not be verified end-to-end through the browser.

A visitor cannot create an account with email+password directly: /login only offers a magic-link email field for customers (plus a broken admin-only password toggle). An account must first exist via magic-link sign-in; only afterward, from /my-orders, can the customer 'Set a new password' (verified: PUT /AccountApi/password -> 200 while signed in as customer2@example.com, and the resulting password does authenticate -- POST /AuthApi/password for customer2@example.com + the new password returned 200 with the correct member user). However the second half of the story ('signing in again later with that email and password returns them to their account') cannot be done through the UI at all, because the only password sign-in control in the app (the same one used for admin) is non-functional -- clicking it fires no request. So the story as written (create via email+password, sign in again with it) is not deliverable end-to-end through the product's UI, even though the underlying API supports password auth.
evidence: PUT https://harbor-street-pizza.immensus-staging.app/preview/AccountApi/password -> 200 'Saved.' while signed in as customer2@example.com
POST https://harbor-street-pizza.immensus-staging.app/preview/AuthApi/password {email:customer2@example.com,password:TestPass123!} -> 200 {role:member,...} (proves the backend password auth works)
Browser click on the only password sign-in button on /login produces 0 network requests -- a customer cannot actually use password sign-in in the browser

stories.message: Signed in as member2 (customer2@example.com via magic link), added an item, checked out as pickup -> POST /CheckoutApi/order 201, GET /OrderConfirmationApi/<code> 200, confirmation page rendered status/payment/fulfilment/items/total identically to a guest order placed in a separate anonymous session. Reloading /my-orders while signed in as the same account showed the order (id b6gIBrjf5eyCX2rYi7XsNX3V77a7qtR5) with date, items and total.

/my-orders, signed in as customer2@example.com, lists the account's own order (id b6gIBrjf5eyCX2rYi7XsNX3V77a7qtR5) with date (Nov 14, 2026), items (1 x QA test description), total (£7.75) and status (Received). A separate order placed as a guest in a different anonymous browser session (id xJk8rvDtwqfLfRA6pPfudDM-TGZdGKBF, no account) does NOT appear in this same account's /my-orders list after reload -- confirmed by comparing order ids, not names.
evidence: GET /CustomerOrderApi (while signed in as member2) -> 200, body lists only order b6gIBrjf5eyCX2rYi7XsNX3V77a7qtR5
Guest order xJk8rvDtwqfLfRA6pPfudDM-TGZdGKBF placed anonymously is absent from that same list on reload

stories.message: Could not sign in as the owner (same admin password sign-in button defect as add-menu-item-works), so the menu editor's photo-upload control could not be reached or exercised.

GET /MenuApi shows photoUrl set for two items (Margherita: /MenuPhotoApi/menu-margherita?v=..., Pepperoni: /MenuPhotoApi/menu-pepperoni?v=...), but both URLs 404 ({"error":"not found"}) whether fetched with or without the query string. On the home page, the browser's own requests for these two photo URLs also returned 404 and logged as console errors, so the items with a photo render a broken image instead of the photo, failing the first acceptance line. Items with no photo (photoUrl: null) render the menu normally with no broken image, satisfying the second acceptance line.
evidence: GET /MenuApi -> 200, items menu-margherita and menu-pepperoni carry non-null photoUrl
Network capture on home page load: GET .../MenuPhotoApi/menu-margherita?v=... -> 404, GET .../MenuPhotoApi/menu-pepperoni?v=... -> 404; console shows 2 'Failed to load resource: 404' errors

consoleErrors: GET /Bootstrap/ -> 403 on every /login page load, logged as a console error (expected refusal since an admin already exists, but surfaces as a console error)
GET /MenuPhotoApi/menu-margherita?v=... -> 404 on home page load, logged as a console error
GET /MenuPhotoApi/menu-pepperoni?v=... -> 404 on home page load, logged as a console error

defects.message: The admin password sign-in submit button on /login does nothing when clicked: no network request, no console error, no DOM change, reproduced across 8+ distinct, verified-correct element selectors. This blocks the owner from reaching any /manage screen through the UI at all, even though POST /AuthApi/password works correctly when called directly with the same credentials (200, correct admin user). This blocked verification of this pass's own stated fix (menu editor writes, order-status writes) through the browser.
GET /Bootstrap/ returns 403 on every /login page load and is logged as a console error, even though this is the expected/correct state once an admin account already exists.

MenuApi publishes photoUrl values (for Margherita and Pepperoni) that point at MenuPhotoApi paths which 404 -- the photo endpoint and the URL it is supposed to serve are out of sync, so every item that has a photo shows a broken image on the public menu.
